Step-by-Step Feature Manual

Master every tool, companion, and mindfulness ritual in MindBloom

✍️

1. Reflect & Plant Seeds

Go to Reflect & Reframe. Select your mood emoji (Calm, Joy, Anxious, Heavy, Grateful). Write your thought or raw vent.

Cognitive Pattern Detector: MindBloom automatically identifies cognitive distortions like Catastrophizing, Imposter Syndrome, or Overthinking.
Reframe & Flower: Write a compassionate reframe and select your flower (Rose, Sunflower, Lavender, Marigold, Jasmine, Lotus).
🛠️

2. Living Garden Tool Belt

Above the canvas, switch between interactive tools for desktop and touch:

  • 🔍 Inspect: Click any flower to open its reflection card, revisit the reframe, and play musical notes.
  • 💧 Water Can: Click or drag across plants to splash refreshing water drops and restore vitality.
  • ☀️ Sun Wand: Shower golden warm sparkles on plants to accelerate growth and blossom radiance.
  • 🦋 Butterflies & Koi: Click anywhere on canvas to spawn fluttering butterflies or feed swimming koi!
🌧️

3. Meet Badal & Gullu

Your loyal emotional companions live right inside the canvas:

☁️
Badal (The Fluffy Cloud): Tap Badal in the sky anytime to trigger wobble physics, cute speech bubbles, and warm chai wisdom!
🐿️
Gullu (The Chipmunk Sprout): Tap Gullu dancing near the flowers for cheerful motivation, happy wiggles, and sprout energy (+15 XP).
☁️

4. Stress Cloud Buster

Need a quick release from mental tension? Start the interactive mini-game:

  1. Click "Pop Stress Clouds" in the garden tool bar.
  2. Drifting clouds with worries like "Overthinking", "Imposter Syndrome", and "Catastrophizing" will float into view.
  3. Click or tap them before they float away to burst them into colorful flower petals with satisfying chime audio!
  4. Build combo multipliers and earn Zen points.
🌦️

5. Indian Mausam & Audio

Customize the atmospheric vibe of your reflection sanctuary:

🌧️ Monsoon (Sawan): Gentle pitter-patter rain, deep greens, and chai steam.
🌺 Vasant (Spring): Drifting pink blossom petals and cheerful birdsong.
☀️ Greeshma (Summer): Golden sun with Suraj Bhai smiling warmly.
🌫️ Shishir (Winter): Crisp morning mist and glowing marigold petals.
🌌 Raat (Night): Starry night sky with glowing fireflies.
🎧 Ambient Studio: Click the headphone icon to mix Om Drone (136.1 Hz), Soft Rain, Birds, Wind Chimes, and Tibetan Singing Bowls!
🪷

6. Daily Rituals & Analytics

Cultivate consistency with guided daily mindfulness tools:

  • 🪷 Lotus Oracle: Click the floating pink lotus in the pond for your daily 3D card reflection prompt!
  • ⏰ Zen Reminders: Set gentle browser alarms for morning intent, mid-day breathe, or evening gratitude.
  • 📊 Emotional Weather: Track streaks, mood distribution, and energy vitality charts.
  • 🌸 Thought Nursery: Search past thoughts, filter by tag, and export or import private journal backups.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Is my journal and reflection data private? ▼

Yes, 100%! All your reflections, thoughts, streaks, and plant growth are saved purely on your own device via your browser's local storage. No thoughts are ever sent to external cloud servers or stored in any database.

Why was audio not playing right away? ▼

Modern web browsers (like Chrome, Safari, and Firefox) automatically mute audio on page load until the user clicks or taps anywhere on the screen. Clicking any tool, mascot, or sound toggle instantly awakens the Web Audio synthesizer.

Can I use MindBloom on my mobile phone? ▼

Yes! MindBloom is fully responsive and supports touch gestures. You can tap Badal or Gullu, drag your finger to water flowers with the Water Can, pop stress clouds, and view your journal on any phone or tablet screen.

Are there keyboard shortcuts? ▼
• W - Switch to Water Can tool
• S - Switch to Sun Wand tool
• I - Switch to Inspect mode
• C - Toggle Stress Cloud Buster mini-game
• Esc - Close any active modal or inspector
